title: Correct T1 calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly apply ideal gas law to find T1 = 0.88 T0 using given p1=1.1p0 and V1=0.8Sl0.

title: Correct T2 calculation
description: Essential: Student must find final temperature T2 = 1.8 T0 for the second equilibrium state.

title: Force balance at first state
description: Important: Student must set up force equilibrium for piston at displacement 0.2l0 to relate applied force F, spring force, and pressures.

title: Force balance at second state
description: Important: Student must set up force equilibrium for piston at displacement 1.2l0, incorporating the same constant applied force F.

title: Spring constant application
description: Important: Student must correctly use given k = p0S/l0 to express spring forces in both equilibrium equations.

title: Ideal gas law linking states
description: Important: Student must apply ideal gas law (pV/T constant) to relate the two final states to the initial state or to each other.

title: Volume identification
description: Optional: Student explicitly identifies volumes V1 = 0.8Sl0 and V2 = 1.2Sl0 from piston displacements.

title: Sign error in spring force
description: Pitfall: Student uses incorrect sign/direction for spring force (compression vs extension) in force balance equations.

title: Pressure unit confusion
description: Pitfall: Student treats pressures as forces without multiplying by area S, or misapplies atmospheric pressure.
